acceptance.requirement: internal red-green cycles retain one attempt, worktree, slot, and writer
ordinary test failure does not enter resource disposition
candidate-green revokes implementer writer and grants verifier read-only
verification rejection regrants one writer on the same issue worktree
retained test services keep unique descendant and port ownership
per-red worktree and global-attempt reconstruction is forbidden
first-failure evidence survives fix cycles and cleanup
dirty worktree is quarantined without force removal
only machine post-inventory can sign resources-clean
member cleanup retains group-owned resources until group cleanup
crash recovery fails on orphans and preserves external resources
